spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:121 `for turn_idx in range(self.max_turns):` bounds the loop; max_turns=18 set via config experiment.yaml:8 -> orchestrator load_config (max_turns=e['max_turns']) -> AgentRunner(max_turns=self.cfg.max_turns) orchestrator.py:140. Loop ends after max_turns iterations, terminating the run.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced loop bound, end-to-end from config to loop.
